Finding 4: Log File Switches
Impact is 10.59 active sessions, 11.68% of total activity.
----------------------------------------------------------
Log file switch operations were consuming significant database time while
waiting for checkpoint completion.
This problem can be caused by use of hot backup mode on tablespaces.  DML to
tablespaces in hot backup mode causes generation of additional redo.

   Recommendation 1: Database Configuration
   Estimated benefit is 10.59 active sessions, 11.68% of total activity.
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Verify whether incremental shipping was used for standby databases.

   Symptoms That Led to the Finding:
   ---------------------------------
      Wait class "Configuration" was consuming significant database time.
      Impact is 13.38 active sessions, 14.76% of total activity.

Finding 3: Hard Parse Due to Literal Usage
Impact is .55 active sessions, 12.63% of total activity.
--------------------------------------------------------
SQL statements were not shared due to the usage of literals. This resulted in
additional hard parses which were consuming significant database time.

   Recommendation 1: Application Analysis
   Estimated benefit is .55 active sessions, 12.63% of total activity.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Investigate application logic for possible use of bind variables instead
      of literals.
   Action
      Alternatively, you may set the parameter "cursor_sharing" to "force".

Finding 8: Hard Parse Due to Sharing Criteria
Impact is .09 active sessions, 2.03% of total activity.
-------------------------------------------------------
SQL statements with the same text were not shared because of cursor
environment mismatch. This resulted in additional hard parses which were
consuming significant database time.
Common causes of environment mismatch are session NLS settings, SQL trace
settings and optimizer parameters.

   Recommendation 1: Application Analysis
   Estimated benefit is .09 active sessions, 2.03% of total activity.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Look for top reason for cursor environment mismatch in
      V$SQL_SHARED_CURSOR.

   Symptoms That Led to the Finding:
   ---------------------------------
      Hard parsing of SQL statements was consuming significant database time.
      Impact is .63 active sessions, 14.66% of total activity.
